Sunday blog: On how to steal a writing style.

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/how-to-ste...
It is unfair to the virility of spreadsheets.
If you make videos on the internet I will not see them. You will not reach me. You do not exist.
Well it’s not so impressive when you consider how much a burrito costs these days (burrito bankrupted me)
I buy practically everything through the @skylightbooks.bsky.social website and have them ship it to me. Feels a million times better than doing the same thing through Amazon.
the haptics on spamming the bark button must be nuts
